title: What are the basic types in TypeScript?
description: string, number, boolean, bigint, symbol, null, undefined, arrays, objects, any, unknown, void and never, and how annotations attach to them.

title: How does type inference work in TypeScript?
description: How TypeScript infers variable, return and generic types, best common type, contextual typing, and when to annotate explicitly.

title: How do you type functions: optional, default and rest parameters?
description: Function type syntax, optional and default parameters, rest parameters, callback types and void returns.

title: What are optional properties and optional chaining in TypeScript?
description: Optional properties (?:), optional chaining (?.), nullish coalescing (??) and how the types change.

title: What is tsconfig.json and which options matter most?
description: The role of tsconfig.json, include/exclude, target, module, lib, strict, outDir, and how tsc picks it up.

title: What is the difference between void, undefined and never as return types?
description: When a function returns void, undefined or never, and why void callbacks may return values.

title: What does as const do?
description: const assertions: readonly literal types for objects, arrays and tuples, and how they feed keyof and indexed access.

title: What is the Record utility type?
description: Record<K, V> for dictionaries and exhaustive maps over a union, versus index signatures and Map.

title: What is type widening and how do you prevent it?
description: How literal types widen to string or number, let vs const, and preventing widening with as const, satisfies and const type parameters.

title: How do you type async functions and Promises?
description: Promise<T> return types, async function inference, typing errors in catch, Promise.all tuples and Awaited.

title: How do you migrate a JavaScript codebase to TypeScript?
description: Incremental migration: allowJs, checkJs, JSDoc types, strictness ramp-up, any budgets and declaration files for untyped dependencies.
